This audit ran under canonkit's own rules (~/AGENTS.md and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md were loaded), and the rubric's knownBias applies to enforcement and governance. Two evaluator deltas of 2 or more (security +5, kit-ci +4) are not anchor looseness: the previous run (f2849c1) was a partial re-score that carried 18 scores from 9add039, and 24 commits between those two, including CI and provenance, had changed what the anchors look at.
